question: Suppose all roots of the polynomial \(P(x)=a_{10}x^{10}+a_9x^9+\cdots+a_1x+a_0\) are real and smaller than 1. Then, for any such polynomial, the function \(\displaystyle f(x)=a_{10}\frac{e^{10x}}{10}+a_9\frac{e^{9x}}9+\cdots+a_1e^x+a_0x,\ x>0\)

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
